gloss: boxed; packed in a box; sheltered; overprotected

definitions.explanation: describing an item that comes packaged in a box, typically implying higher quality or a gift presentation
describing a person, especially a young woman, who has been raised in a sheltered, protective environment with little exposure to the outside world

examples.japanese: {箱入|はこい}りのお{菓子|かし}を{買|か}った。
この{箱入|はこい}りのワインは{贈|おく}り{物|もの}にぴったりだ。
examples.english: This boxed wine is perfect as a gift.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}が{厳|きび}しかったので、{姉|あね}は{箱入|はこい}り{娘|むすめ}として{育|そだ}った。
examples.english: Because my father was strict, my older sister was raised as a sheltered girl.

examples.japanese: {箱入|はこい}り{娘|むすめ}だった{彼女|かのじょ}は、{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らしを{始|はじ}めて{苦労|くろう}した。
examples.english: Having been a sheltered girl, she struggled when she started living on her own.

examples.japanese: あの{家|いえ}のお{嬢|じょう}さんは{箱入|はこい}りで、{世間|せけん}のことをあまり{知|し}らない。
examples.english: That family's young lady is sheltered and doesn't know much about the real world.

examples.japanese: {大切|たいせつ}な{品物|しなもの}なので{箱入|はこい}りで{保管|ほかん}してある。
examples.english: It's a precious item, so it's stored in a box.

notes:
Literally "put in a box." The literal sense (sense 1) refers to items packaged in boxes, often implying quality or gift-readiness. The figurative sense (sense 2) describes someone raised in a protected environment, kept safe from the outside world like a treasured item in a box.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {箱入|はこい}り{娘|むすめ}: sheltered daughter — the most common figurative usage
- {箱入|はこい}り{息子|むすこ}: sheltered son — less common but used similarly
- {箱入|はこい}りのお{菓子|かし}: boxed sweets

CULTURAL NOTE:
The expression {箱入|はこい}り{娘|むすめ} traditionally described daughters from good families who were carefully protected from the outside world. In modern usage, it can carry either a positive nuance (well-bred, innocent) or a slightly critical one (naive, lacking worldly experience).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {世間知|せけんし}らず: naive about the world — focuses on the result of being sheltered
- お{嬢様|じょうさま}{育|そだ}ち: raised like a young lady — similar connotation of privileged upbringing
